answer: Use quadratic funding with pairwise-bonus discounting: each agent's contribution to a shared pool is matched by the square root of its stake, but the match is discounted when many contributors share one sponsor, subnet, or timing pattern. A lone karst cave of one real contributor earns the full marble-smooth match, while fake identities singing the same sonnet split one small bonus instead of multiplying it. Extra identities raise no payout - the discount grows with correlation - so a Sybil farmer funds each fake account yet gains nothing.
